recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆大型組織球，細胞質淡染、充滿大小一致的細小空泡（泡沫狀，foamy），核小而偏位，周圍是正常造血細胞，符合 Niemann-Pick 細胞。
features: Single large histiocyte, several times the diameter of adjacent myeloid cells
Abundant pale cytoplasm packed with uniform small clear vacuoles (foamy / soap-bubble appearance)
Small, eccentric, irregular nucleus with low N:C ratio
No striated or crinkled-paper cytoplasm and no sea-blue coloration
Background of maturing granulocytes, lymphocytes and normocytic red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows trilineage hematopoietic elements with a conspicuous large histiocyte in the center of the field. The histiocyte has abundant pale cytoplasm filled with numerous uniform small lipid vacuoles and a small eccentric nucleus. The cytoplasm lacks the fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' texture of Gaucher cells. Findings are consistent with lipid-laden foam cells of Niemann-Pick disease in the appropriate clinical and enzymatic/genetic context.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than discrete uniform vacuoles.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green granules on Romanowsky stain, whereas this cell is pale and uniformly vacuolated.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher / foamy macrophages in high cell turnover or hyperlipidemia
ddx.vs: Secondary foamy macrophages are morphologically similar, so enzyme assay (acid sphingomyelinase) or NPC1/NPC2 testing and clinical context are needed.
